reviews.text: We had an excellent experience working with Sam from Elite Pro Remodeling! He handled our foundation repair, level 4 wall finish, and full house painting — and the results are outstanding. The foundation was leveled perfectly, and the walls and paint look smooth and professional. Sam was punctual, detail-oriented, and made sure every step was done right. Our home looks amazing thanks to his hard work and skill. Highly recommend Sam and the Elite Pro Remodeling team for any foundation or painting projects — top-quality work and great service!

reviews.text: Elite Handyman did an amazing job on my property! They are fast, responsive, and care a lot about the quality of what you do. reviews.text:
My pier & beam home was built in 1935. We discovered a leak at the kitchen sink drain in the exterior wall. It leaked for years until the floor sank down. This caused years of water damage to occurr without my wife and I knowing about it.

Floor tiles had to be removed without damage. Four (4) floor joise had to be removed and replaced. The exterior wall at the base had to be rebuilt along with the bottom plate.

My Home Depot cabinets..3 of then were ruined. Particle board just crumbled...it was a mess.

Lucky for me I called Emanuel with Elite Handyman Service & Remodeling. His Top Knotch employees Angel, Ricardo and Juan showed up and flat out got after it for five days. Holy Cow removing the old floor joise and replacing with new ones was a job.

Regarding....Angel the Lead Tehc,. wow ! ..he is a Master Tradesman and can do anything.

Now I need three matching cabinets built asap!!!!

Elite in order to expedite the job (thank u) called "The Tools Handyman" owned by Mr. Guillermo Ruiz. He was on my driveway unless than 24 hours. Cabinets were built on the spot with real wood. We were able to save the faces of the damaged cabinets and used them They turned out excellent. True craftsmanship. Thank you Sir.

Granit countertops with sink were removed and replaced without damage. Copper soldering..cast iron repairs...all .done...Holy Cow

Also had an attic access door installed !!!

The scope of the job was huge with allot of unknowns. Elite Handyman & Remodeling did the job in FIVE (5) days. Finished...no leaks....My wife and I are Extremely pleased with their work.

Everything in five days....very pleased obviously but I can't help it. Would recommend their Service to anyone. Thanks Elite !!!!

reviews.text: Technicians were timely and friendly. Knowledgeable about my stairlift issue. Repair was quick. Already found additional projects to use this company for.  Highly recommended for your handyman jobs.

reviews.text:
I cannot speak more highly of our experience with Elite Handyman & Remodeling - If you’re looking for a one-stop shop, look no further. After obtaining bids from multiple vendors for a COMPLETE renovation of the master bathroom, I went with Emmanuel because he seemed the most clear, transparent, and fairly priced while still being reasonable. He also helped me work through cost options so I could stay in budget. They did everything from demo, rerouting plumbing, drawing new electrical lines, drywall, tile/grout, shower pan/drain slope, and all related install. Communication was consistent throughout the process, we knew what was happening when. As for workmanship, the pictures speak for themselves.

I am painfully OCD and take special note of tiling and grout work. Jovani’s tile job and overall install of the project is perfectly precise, the time spent achieving exact measurements and placement is evident. We LOVE the finished product and have more projects in the pipeline we will use Emmanuel’s team for!
reviews.author: Callie Barfield

reviews.text: Prompt, professional and thorough.  Job was completed on time and under the original estimate.  I will definitely use Elite Handyman & Remodeling again and would recommend them!
reviews.author: Jennifer Owen

reviews.text: The team worked hard and made sure a challenging job was done right. Excellent communication throughout, kept the work area clean so we could go about our day. Very professional work.
reviews.author: JC

reviews.text:
Why four stars and not five? I'll explain. We had four basic things done, mount TV on brick fireplace, hang picture, Fix drywall and paint in 2 bathrooms. The picture was hung with ease; centered, beautiful. They fixed the drywall in both bathrooms. They did a terrific job--they being Jeremy, Jesse and Brevan. Painting and drywall look really good--as good or better than original!
When they finished mounting the TV, which they centered well, Jeremy told me I'd have to find a thinner plug for my Fire Stick because that plug was too thick and would not fit. Here's the thing--now I have to go problem solve this myself, then have the wife help me lift off and on the TV. They should have measured to mount it so the plug would fit. So I am not pleased with having my wife have to do some heavy lifting as well as extra time spent. Hence the 4-stars. Would I use them again? Probably. I'd just oversee more maybe....
...Contractor reached out after this review. Response was very professional and above and beyond. Much appreciate responsiveness and quality of response.
reviews.author: Martin Brook

reviews.text: Cannot say enough good things about this business! They do things right, are kind and diligent, pricing is appropriate to the work they do. They have done work at my house several times now and have always been consistently excellent. 10/10, highly recommend!

reviews.text: We are a very satisfied customer!  The team was very responsive and provided a comprehensive estimate, schedule, and stuck to it!  We completed our garage remodel in about three days with paint, cabinets, and reorganization.  Great job and will work with Elite again!
reviews.author: Pierce Ables

reviews.text:
Elite installed laminate wood flooring for me in a small detached den. The job was done with good quality and expertly. I was grateful to Elite to agree to take this job - I had a hard time finding a residential small flooring job contractor in Dallas.

Personally, I wouldn't likely use Elite in the future because of high cost. The labor for the job was $2.5k-$3k what I remember, and the job took less than 8-10 hours by one worker. This seemed higher than the per hour and per square foot standards I saw online. Additionally, I was quoted $8k for a separate related job to install a French drain to stop outside water from entering the floor. I requested a quote from another company which then installed the French drain for me for $2k (with no water issues since).

I wasn't going to submit this review because it would not be 5 stars. I'd gotten what I hired, and I would just look for lower-price alternatives next time. I posted this review because I keep getting repeated emails and text from Elite asking me to submit feedback. I don't wish to be contacted.
reviews.author: Darina Janovova

reviews.text: EH&R did a wonderful job replacing a hallway attic door in the ceiling!  Great seal now and they were nice and efficient. Completely cleaned up afterwards. I am very happy with their work and will use them again.

The work he and his helpers do is first class. I strongly recommend Elite Handymen.

reviews.text: I was very impressed with Emmanuel and his crew at Elite Handyman and Remodeling. It is very difficult to find skilled, honest, reliable workmen these days, but these guys were tops. We needed some painting indoor and out, as well as sheetrock repair in one room and minor wall corner repair in another. In addition, he sent me an electrician who was also fantastic. Their prices were very reasonable in fact Emannuel had originally estimated three men to do the job but when he arrived, he said it would only take two. They worked almost all day and Emmauel without my asking reduced his original quote by one third (unheard of). They will be making some outdoor door installs for items I ordered which will include staining, sealing, and mounting with hardware. I will be using these guys for all my repairs and remodels in the future. Highly recommended and I am very particular.
reviews.author: LARRY SHAPIRO

reviews.text:
We've had the pleasure of working with Elite Handyman & Remodeling on five different projects now, and they have consistently exceeded our expectations each time. Their team is incredibly professional, always maintaining a high standard of work and demonstrating great attention to detail.

One of the standout qualities of Elite Handyman is their ability to work within our budget without compromising on quality. They listen to our needs and provide cost-effective solutions, which has been a huge relief for us. Their transparency and honesty about costs have built a trust that is rare to find.

Punctuality and adherence to the schedule are also hallmarks of their service. They have never missed an appointment and always complete the projects within the promised timeframe. This reliability has made our renovation experiences smooth and stress-free.

Overall, Elite Handyman is simply the best to work with. Their professionalism, dedication, and commitment to customer satisfaction set them apart. We will undoubtedly continue to rely on their excellent services for future projects. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: Very courteous and professional. Angel did a great job building my shed.

I was also frustrated with the fact that they were going to charge me to fix something that they didn't fix correctly in a prior visit (e.g. the moulding around my attic ladder).

We had several small jobs that needed to be done in our bathrooms. Emmanuel was so responsive to our initial request, responding immediately and quickly providing an estimate and appointment time. He and his crew were so professional and neat. They arrived right on time and did an excellent job in a very timely manner. We will definitely use them again!

UPDATE: Emmanuel and his wonderful crew just finished adding a small deck to our back porch. Once again, their work exceeded our expectations! The little extra touches on the railing really made our deck special. Once again, communication was excellent.

UPDATE 2: Emmanuel and his crew installed a new vent in our small bathroom. Once again, the communication was exemplary. Emmanuel provided a time window in advance. We were notified when the crew was on the way (they were right on time). The work was finished quickly, professionally, and thoroughly. They vacuumed and Swiffered the floor! Where else can you find service like that?! We cannot recommend them more.

reviews.text: We hired Elite Handyman to install new shades in our Downtown Dallas condo. Everything went smoothly. The owner, Emmanuel, listened to our requirements carefully. He provided proof of insurance – which is a must for working in a downtown highrise. He corresponded with me via text and email beforehand so we could arrange for parking and other details. Finally, when he arrived, he had no issues parking and getting in our building. Hanging the curtains went smoothly and the quality of work was top notch. Overall, I highly recommend this handyman company.

reviews.text: Immanuel's crews are amazing!! I had them first come out to repair drywall and baseboards in a challenging spot in our garage. It was a flawless job and the crew was very professional. We had them back out for a 4 day interior job, including painting ceilings, walls, trim, and doors, as well as a bathroom remodel. They completely removed our old tile shower and pan, added a new custom partial wall, then water proofed the inside of the shower to prep it for a cultured marble company. I previously hired a random home depot "professional" who got paint on my wood floors when he did the baseboards, left streaks on my doors and trim, and did not do any caulking at all. Imagine my surprise and relief when the Elite Handyman crew showed up and spent the entire first day meticulously prepping for paint!! All flooring was covered with multiple layers for protection, holes were filled in, cracks and corners were caulked, etc. I have had 2 different crews here for the jobs and both were clean, respectful, professional, and very skilled. 11/10 recommend!!!

reviews.text:
I initially requested the team do what's needed to repair one ceiling surface, which included removing wallpaper, skimming and painting to a smooth flat finish. I ended up doing a second ceiling and the quality of their work really changed the freshness of the rooms. They also patched drywall in two bathrooms and performed other tasks on my initial punchlist.

The team, led by Emmanuel, was very responsive on potential 'scope' increases, on time, and came in under the initial estimate provided. I would recommend them even for larger projects and will be calling them again.
